svg.aria-label: OpenFix implementation architecture: scanner reports from Snyk, Semgrep, GitHub and Trivy flow into the OpenFix core (ingest, policy, engine, agent, verify), which talks to Claude, Gemini, OpenAI, Grok or Ollama, runs in a git worktree and Docker sandbox, and writes receipts, SARIF and GitHub draft pull requests.
